task: 交互式 3D 自行车工作室与装配模拟器 / Custom Bicycle Builder & Assembly Simulator

parts: frame(head/top/down/seat tube, chainstay/seatstay, BB shell, front/rear dropouts, derailleur hanger)

parametricFrameGeometry.compactnessSlider: continuous 0-100%: changes top-tube slope (shortens seat tube), head-tube length and seatpost extension as a combination, not a uniform scale
parametricFrameGeometry.droppedSeatstay: traditional vs dropped toggle truly lowers the seatstay attachment ~155mm and adds a dropped strut + curved stay

drivetrainAndFit.cassette: 7-12 speed; tooth count / width / spacing / taper change visibly

nprVisuals.celShading: MeshToonMaterial + DataTexture gradientMap (3/4/5/6 selectable tone-separation steps)
nprVisuals.inkOutlines: custom post-process edge pass on depth + luminance (Roberts-cross), screen-space constant width, adjustable
nprVisuals.brightReadableBaseline: hemisphere+key+fill+rim+ambient lights, light studio background; verified mean luminance ~118/255, ink coverage restrained (~3.8% of frame)

environment.scene: scaled but uncluttered bike workshop: gridded floor + work mat, two walls, ceiling light panels, workbench (vise/toolbox/cans/wrenches), wall pegboard with tools, two wall-hung wheels, storage rack with boxes/tires, repair stand, tire stack, bucket, fake contact shadows

uiAndSpecs.estimatedWeight: responds to config (verified 7.88-8.32 kg across scenarios, never static)
extras: OrbitControls with damping; geometry updates never reset the camera

engineeringQuality.reuseGeometry: geometry cache keyed by dimensions (geoCache ~100 entries)
engineeringQuality.sharedMaterials: single material per color group, updated in place
engineeringQuality.noConsoleErrors: verified via headless Chromium: 0 page errors, 0 console errors

selfTest.method: local headless Chromium (system Chrome + puppeteer-core), file served over local HTTP; SwiftShader software WebGL
